name: SKAN Group AG
summary: SKAN Group AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides isolators, cleanroom devices, and decontamination processes for pharmaceutical and chemical industries in Europe, the Americas, Asia, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Equipment and Solutions; and Services and Consumables. The company offers accessories, biological indicators, digital ventures, isolators, cleanroom, laminar flow, particle counter, personal protective equipment, safety workbench, transfer systems, and fume cupboard. It also provides digital solutions, lifecycle support, laboratory services, and SKAN labs. The company was formerly known as BV Holding AG and changed its name to SKAN Group AG in October 2021…
